item.title: Noise
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Carmine, Deeper
  • 発売日: 2005-12-09
  • スコア: 6.87/10 (13 人評価)
  • 日本語名: NOISE－ノイズ－
  • 英語名: Noise

别名

  • The Noise

あらすじ

The main character, Inu (“dog” in Japanese), was left by his father when he was very young. He was adopted by a sadistic couple who gave him daily beatings. One day, he suddenly starts to read the thoughts of the old couple and learns that he can be killed any second, so he dares to rebel. He kills both of them and runs away.
